notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP only - robots.txt (Shopify default) has no full-site Disallow and no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot block, so tier (a) was permitted throughout; homepage + robots.txt + sitemap.xml fetched via urllib with a browser UA, no blocks encountered. TREE: union of (1) live mega-menu extracted from homepage HTML (enhanced-megamenu markup, all <details data-link-handle> sections: bestsellers/our-collections/design-studio/trade-b2b/new/furniture/decor-pillows/rugs/pottery/lighting/bath/dining/art/gifts/sale), (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (435 collection URLs), (3) footer links. Site is Shopify + Searchspring (SNAP) merchandising, siteId 'qva9ht' - the product grids on collection pages are client-hydrated by Searchspring, so counts were pulled via Searchspring's own public JSON API (https://qva9ht.a.searchspring.io/api/search/search.json?siteId=qva9ht&resultsFormat=native&bgfilter.collection_handle=<handle>) which is the actual backend data source the page's own JS calls - not a proxy/cache - so this stayed within tier (a). h1 spot-checked on every leaf recorded to confirm slug->node match. EXCLUDED (checked, not textile/storage): Decor (Vases/Trays/Candles/Candle Holders/Decorative Objets/Games/Bowls/Picture Frames) - decorative accessories; Wall Decor (Mirrors/Wall Art) - separate category; Outdoor>Planters - decorative; the 'Collections' menu column (Acrylic/Brass/Beaded/Madrid/Needlepoint/Pompidou) - named design-line collections, not category nodes, and Needlepoint pillows are already counted inside 'Pillows'; Bath Accessories (soap dishes/tumblers/tissue boxes/wastebaskets/trays, verified via product-name sample) - decorative bath accessories, not textile, not primarily storage; Bath>Candles/Mirrors - other categories; beach-towels and playa-beach-towels standalone collections - exact-duplicate/subset of the Beach Towel portion already counted inside 'Towels and Mats' (same 4 products), and playa-beach-towels is a named design-collection page; fabric-swatches - lives only in the footer 'Customer Service' block next to Contact Us/Help Center, i.e. a swatch-ordering utility page, not a merchandised product category; Organization>Boxes (decor-category-decorative-boxes, 63) - product-name sample (Pill Boxes, Lacquer Boxes, Globo Box) and its own product_type facet ('Decorative Box':51) confirm these are decorative trinket boxes, not functional storage; Organization>Books & Bookends - decorative, not storage; Pottery/Dining tabletop/serveware/drinkware, Furniture (incl. dressers-chests, etageres-cabinets, all explicitly under the site's own Furniture nav), Lighting, Art - out of scope categories entirely. INCLUDED WITH CAVEATS: 'Rugs by Category' (Peruvian Flat Weave/Hand-Knotted/Outdoor) and 'Rugs by Shape > Novelty' are live sitemap collections (HTTP 200, correct h1, real Searchspring counts) but are NOT reachable from the current live mega-menu or footer - flagged MEDIUM per the brief's mega-menu+sitemap union rule. The entire 'Bedding' branch (by-category: Sheet Sets/Duvet Sets/Pillowcases & Shams/Quilts & Coverlets; by-fabric: Linen/Percale/Sateen) is likewise sitemap-only - zero occurrences of 'bedding' anywhere in the homepage HTML (main nav or footer) - flagged MEDIUM for the same reason; 'Bedding by Category > Accent Pillows' (bedding-by-category-accent-pillows) was dropped as a same-count/same-product_type duplicate of the already-recorded 'Pillows' node (both 82 items, type Pillow). Storage>Jewelry Boxes and Storage>Canisters kept at MEDIUM: Jewelry Boxes are styled as decorative lacquer/leather boxes but the site itself files them under its 'Organization' nav column (storage.md SS7 Organizers); Canisters (dining-tabletop-cookie-jars-canisters) are dual-filed under both Dining>Tabletop and Decor&Pillows>Organization - kept as Storage per the site's own Organization placement. QTY: every qty is Searchspring pagination.totalResults for that exact collection_handle (bgfilter), read directly off the API JSON, never estimated or summed.
